route.semantics: create-only custom agent; optional operation_id; no name-based upsert or uniqueness policy

authority.service: current User re-read; active status; WORKSPACE_ADMIN+; claim is_active/status/role/raw tenant/raw workspace in the create transaction
authority.scope: created row uses the actor's resolved tenant/workspace; body identity/scope/tier fields are ignored
authority.authority_change: 409 AUTHORITY_CHANGED with effect=none and no row

material.sensitive_material: no raw configuration, schedule or secret in the receipt or logs

effect.receipt: one AuditLog action=agent_created in the same transaction
effect.readback: fresh session; receipt and exact created-material digest must verify
effect.scheduler: only after the first verified create; never on replay
effect.states: verified; already_applied; refused 401/403/422; conflict 409 AUTHORITY_CHANGED/OPERATION_CONFLICT; not_applied 409; committed_unverified 503

parallel_writers.guided: POST /api/agents/guided still direct-commits; not repaired in this slice
parallel_writers.spawn: POST /api/agents/spawn persists through register_or_update_agent (create-or-upsert); not repaired in this slice
